thread:
maria-support: @kyle-sre heads up, priority customer (acme-inc) reporting p99 spikes ~8s and some 504 errors on dedicated pool eu-west at 10:30am PST.
jon-customer: saw it in Support — customer pasted logs showing many requests queued, then timeouts. they saw sudden drop in attached GPUs.
kyle-sre: on it. can you paste p95/p99 numbers and the pool id? also which model variant?
maria-support: p95 1.2s, p99 8.2s. pool id pool-eu-7, model: gptx-large-quant. hits started at ~10:27, peaked 10:29-10:33.
deploy-bot: autoscale: pool-eu-7 requested_scale_up -> 3 nodes, attached_nodes 0 -> 1 @10:29:41, full_attach @10:31:03. attach_latency: 82s for first node, 18s for second.
anita-eng-platform: attach latency 82s sounds like cold-gpu start + image pull. checking image registry metrics.
kyle-sre: can we repro locally with loadgen? @maria-support can you give a repro script from customer or consent to run trace?
maria-support: customer provided curl loop, sending it now. small tokenized requests, qps ~120 for a minute.
sre-oncall: looking at provisioning queue — saw backlog spike to 450 during burst. fairshare slot allocation delayed some reserved pools.
kyle-sre: suspect thundering attach: many concurrent attach requests caused API server queueing -> delayed handshake -> longer cold start. Also kernel image pull timeout for first nodes.
anita-eng-platform: putting up quick mitigation: 1) enable prewarm for pool-eu-7 (min_idle=2) 2) temporary route priority customer to hosted fallback model with matched latency profile 3) start canary image warmup to avoid big pulls.
maria-support: customer ok with fallback for the next 30m, they want ETA for rollback.
jon-customer: confirm we accept fallback, prefer not to change prompt. thanks.
kyle-sre: mitigation steps executed: scaled min_idle to 2 @10:40, started hosted route for acme-inc @10:42. monitoring...
deploy-bot: route-change: acme-inc -> hosted-fallback-model applied @10:42:17
sre-oncall: after fallback, p99 dropped to 1.1s for their requests. provisioning queue drained by 10:48.
anita-eng-platform: root cause: registry concurrent pulls + cold kernel init under heavy attach concurrency. follow-ups: reduce image size, add progressive pull, randomize attach backoff, and prewarm strategy per priority tenant.
kyle-sre: action items: (1) eng-platform to add randomized attach jitter (anita) (2) infra to add progressive image layering to reduce first-pull (infra, @infra) (3) support to notify customer of follow-up (maria). I'll open an incident ticket with timeline.
maria-support: will send update to customer, thanks. :thumbsup: 
jon-customer: appreciate the quick help, saving our release. :relieved:
kyle-sre: filing INC-2026 with timeline and logs. assigning to anita and infra for postmortem.
anita-eng-platform: copying logs and creating repro harness to simulate 500 concurrent attach on staging.
maria-support: leaving here, ping if you need me.
